method: quantile-mapped from E5's thresholds (siglip2_base_384_rc4 Qdrant vectors) onto Scene Atlas-style ONNX embeddings of 400 px medium thumbnails; grouping/e5/calibrate.py
leaf_method: leaf_diff / leaf_same_prod / leaf_same: E6 change 2 (leaf default, positive different-map evidence) cohesion cuts, tuned on the dev small-import suite with the medium SA embeddings; medium keeps the tuned values (0.55 / 0.80 / 0.84).
leaf_source: E6, tuned on the medium SA embeddings
scene_method: scene_agree_emb: E7 R5 scene agreement (edge map >= 0.50, a parameter, AND embedding cosine >= this), tuned on the E7 dev suites with the medium SA embeddings; medium keeps the tuned value 0.85.
scene_source: E7, tuned on the medium SA embeddings
